pages.text: Beset by smouldering tendrils of flame-coloured growth, this bulb is purported by some to grow into an even more powerful plant.$(br2)Such a specimen has yet to be observed or be recorded.$(br2)Once found amongst volcanoes and in hellish landscapes, it can now be crafted through the heat of a $(l:crafting/pyres)pyre$() and is renewable.
